name: Vršovka (Czechia)
description: Two horizontal stripes of green and red in the ratio 1:1, with a white serrated vertical stripe at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 30 November 2007 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
